channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Maxi Kleber | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Maxi Kleber from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Marcus Morris on Maxi Kleber, Dorian Finney-Smith
item.description:
Marcus said at the 7:32 mark.

“So I think that they probably noticed that and they wanted Luka to feel better going to a new place where you have somebody who has been a teammate. Also Dorian Finney-Smith has been [Doncic's teammate]. Maxi Kleber. So I think that really helped. Also ‘Kieff played there, so the Lakers really wanted him to come. ‘Bron asked for him to come.”

Marcus Morris on Maxi Kleber, Dorian Finney-Smith, Mar 24, 2025. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dennis Schroder on Maxi Kleber
item.description:
Kleber had announced that he’ll sit out the upcoming World Cup due to Schroder’s comments.

“I would like to apologize to Maxi Kleber and his family for my statements and the inconvenience they caused,”

Dennis Schroder on Maxi Kleber, Jul 23, 2023. Source: EuroHoops.net.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Maxi Kleber
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on what he wants to see:

“No open 3s, we want to run Tim Hardaway off the 3-point line... as well as Kleber. Make them put the ball on the floor.”

Tyronn Lue on Maxi Kleber, May 30, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Maxi Kleber
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Maxi Kleber:

“We felt he's one of the most valuable two-way players on our team. He's gotten better each year. We really are looking for him to continue to grow.”

Rick Carlisle on Maxi Kleber, Dec 6, 2020. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.
